title: The hospital parking lot, v
logline: Friday. The last lot strip. Wood drives out. The strip looks back once through the rear window at the sign and draws it smaller than it is.

panels.composition: Morning. The Datsun starting. Exhaust. WOOD at the wheel, BARNABY up on the seat.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a rusted small car starting in a hospital lot at gray morning with exhaust rising, a man at the wheel and a dog on the seat

panels.composition: The rear window. The H sign in it, receding. Drawn smaller than perspective allows.
props: the H in the rear window, too small

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a car's rear window with a blue-H sign receding in it drawn noticeably smaller than it should be, no words
image.notes: The sign too small on purpose. The strip is shrinking the week.

panels.composition: 101. The sea. The dog's nose out the window. Wood's face: the face for driving.

panels.composition: Gully's. The end stool. Coffee already poured. Wood sitting. Gully not asking. The dog under the stool. The week over; the strip never said what it was.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man sitting down at a bait-shop's end stool where a coffee is already poured, a man in an apron not asking, a dog beneath, no words

notes: The H drawn too small. Gully doesn't ask. Never named.
